model_output.verdict: A structural and pipe welder with a strong inspection record and one vague shutdown bullet.
write_up: A recruiter sees structural steel fabrication, process piping and the certifications to match. The current job makes your work easy to picture, from reading drawings to fitting assemblies within 1/16 inch.
The Riverfront Tower inspection line is the model: it names the job, the tests and about 900 welds. The plant shutdown bullet leaves a question about what you did during those shifts.

cards.line: - Passed every third-party UT and visual inspection on the Riverfront Tower job (about 900 welds)
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this. It gives a recruiter a named project and an inspection record without making them guess how much work was involved.
